title: HateXplain: A Benchmark Dataset for Explainable Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating unintended identity-based bias in hate speech classification using AUC-based metrics (Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, BNSP AUC, Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs) across racial groups such as African, Arab, Asian, Caucasian, and Hispanic communities.

Evaluating unintended identity-based bias in hate speech classification using AUC-based metrics (Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, BNSP AUC, Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs) across religious groups such as Islam, Jewish, Buddhism, Christian, and Hindu.

Evaluating unintended identity-based bias in hate speech classification using AUC-based metrics (Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, BNSP AUC, Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs) comparing classifications mentioning Women and Men.

Evaluating unintended identity-based bias in hate speech classification using AUC-based metrics (Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, BNSP AUC, Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs) for sexual orientations, specifically distinguishing between Gay and Heterosexual mentions.

Evaluating unintended identity-based bias in hate speech classification using AUC-based metrics (Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, BNSP AUC, Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs) for populations identified as Refugees or Immigrants.
